general_information.Description: Description: In this course, student will learn the best ways to engage an audience they want and need by smartly implementing their important, strategic stories and information and by using proven tools and techniques to enhance an audience’s experiences and interest. Students will learn how effectively utilize AI to develop, organize and implement a content marketing strategy, analyze and measure the effectiveness of content marketing, write compelling copy, use a strategic framework when writing, and build your professional brand and authority through content marketing. Lecturer will use several teaching methods such as conducting group discussion and sharing field work experiences in the market on top of regular teaching. Students will have the chance to showcase their presentation and media products as well as their thinking process related to this field.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must at least 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final presentation - Student is responsible to do all exercises, questions, assignments given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

description: Description: In this course, student will learn the best ways to engage an audience they want and need by smartly implementing their important, strategic stories and information and by using proven tools and techniques to enhance an audience’s experiences and interest. Students will learn how effectively utilize AI to develop, organize and implement a content marketing strategy, analyze and measure the effectiveness of content marketing, write compelling copy, use a strategic framework when writing, and build your professional brand and authority through content marketing. Lecturer will use several teaching methods such as conducting group discussion and sharing field work experiences in the market on top of regular teaching. Students will have the chance to showcase their presentation and media products as well as their thinking process related to this field.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the role of Content strategy at all levels of an organization to engage an audience they want and need by smartly implementing their important, strategic stories and information.
Understand how best to engage your audience by implementing their stories and using proven tools and techniques to enhance an audience’s experience and interests.
Knowledge of manage content once created by learning how best to tell an organization’s “content story” across media platforms using a human-centered design.
Finding actionable ways to grow internal and external audiences, and expand your content’s reach.
Create and implement engaging content across media platforms that the people you want to reach will really value.
Apply the skills you've learned throughout the courses in response to a real challenge facing organizations today.

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the class
assessments.Grading Guide: Students are required to form groups of 4 members and create a content channel plan for a selected brand, integrating AI tools at different stages of the process. The plan should include: Business Overview Customer Research Content Production Content Scheduling . Keyword Selection & SEO Action Plan should detail: The persona The content goal Primary content type, structure, tone, and editorial plan Channel integration Desired actions
assessments.Note: According to the predetermined LOs, lecturers have the flexibility to choose assignment forms. Each assignment has a six-day due date, which commences when the lecture provides detailed instructions.

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the class
assessments.Grading Guide: Suggested assignment requirements: Students will be required to create a buyer persona for their most love brand through the lens of theories discussed in class. This practice is intended to help students identify basic concepts and principles of content marketing by analysing their insight thought such issues as: its relationship to the brand, brand strategy, brand's targeted audience, and some other characteristics. Where possible, students should link their analysis to the course materials, including readings, lecture notes, and screenings.Students will be required to write specific content (content mission, content type, content flatform …) or report based on the topics given out by the lecturers.

schedule.Student's Tasks: Lecture Q&A/ Discussions Explore content trends: identify current media/online trends relevant to brands or social issues. Use AI for ideation: generate content ideas, campaign hooks, or storytelling directions from AI tools. Adapt & refine: critically filter AI results, select the most relevant ideas, and develop them into concrete stories (posts, scripts, or visuals). Collaborate in groups: divide roles (trend research, AI prompt design, story adaptation, visual draft). Present output: share AI-assisted content trend ideas as short stories or sample posts; explain how AI contributed. Reflect: discuss strengths, limitations, and ethical issues of AI in content creation (originality, bias, over-reliance).
